comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
To create this weapon, you must perform Transmutation Alchemy in your quarters (with the correct furniture of Transmutation Alchemy Equipment or Complex Alchemy Equipment installed).

Skills: Alchemy/Handicrafts R15
Base Item: Apotolos Amina
Ingredients:
Core of a Bronze Statue x1
Axe Fragment x1
Orichalcum x1

If successful, the Apotolos Amina EX will be created. It can then be further strengthened at the Priest located at the back of the Temple of Poseidon which can only be accessed from the Acropolis of Atlantis -- and only if Atlantis is currently in UWO.

Recipe name: Forging the Broken Pillar

Skills: Alchemy/Handicrafts R15
Base Item: Apotolos Amina EX
Ingredients: Gelatin x10
Core of a Bronze Statue x1

Using the above process, it is apparently possible to enhance the Apotolos Amina EX to 100 Defense. Although untested on Maris server as of this post, it is possible to craft the [DBLINK:00419001 to 100 Defense, so I don't see why it wouldn't be possible to do with the Apotolos Amina EX as well.

Just keep in mind that as the UWODB sometimes warns, "It's very hard to do." Cheers.

Source: wittyship.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-1360.html
